name: PUKA
sourceLaw: JM bodies govern; browser code hosts the output
deliveryLaw: For estate-hosted web bodies, hand the owner the singular live direct door every time. Sandbox/package routes are fallback or archival, not the primary contact path.

humanGame.declaredReadBoundary: A locked read is a provisional interpretation of public table behaviour. Later public consequence may support, correct or leave it unresolved; it never becomes proof of motive or personality.
humanGame.calibrationBoundary: Read calibration receives only the declared-read ledger. Supported means later public consequence moved in the same direction; it never means hidden state or motive became fact.
humanGame.patternWindowBoundary: Pattern comparison receives only resolved declared-read signal, confidence, street and public-consequence outcomes. Repetition, correction, contradiction and recent-versus-longer movement remain provisional and never become hidden-state, motive, personality or real-person proof.
humanGame.keeper: READ THE HUMAN GAME WITHOUT PRETENDING THE READ IS THE HUMAN.
humanGame.counterreadKeeper: READ THE TABLE -> READ YOUR READ.
humanGame.patternWindowKeeper: A PATTERN MAY EARN ATTENTION. CONTRADICTION KEEPS IT CORRIGIBLE.
humanGame.kernel: CONTACT -> OBSERVE -> DECLARE -> TEST -> CONSEQUENCE -> TRACE -> CALIBRATE -> CORRECT

laws: No restart: restore before rebuild
One game state, multiple presentation routes
Presentation organs may read visible state but must not infer expose or duplicate hidden game state
Human Game receives sanitised visible action history only and does not receive the poker engine, deck, hidden House cards or persistence store
Behavioural table reads are revisable interpretations of gameplay actions, not personality diagnoses or proof of motive
A declared read must be committed before its later consequence if it is to count as a tested read
A declared read may be supported corrected or unresolved; it is never retroactively promoted into motive fact
Read calibration may evaluate the player's declared confidence against public consequence but may not promote support into hidden-state proof
Pattern windows may compare bounded resolved declared reads but may not promote repetition into hidden-state motive personality or real-person proof
A pattern may earn attention; contradiction keeps it corrigible
Same-signal support and correction must remain visible together rather than being averaged into fake certainty
Recent contact may differ from a longer pattern window and must remain available as a re-reading route
Context may change the read without changing the mechanical game truth
Correction is feedback on the read model, not judgement of the person being read
BLUFF? is always a candidate interpretation and requires visible pressure evidence before it can be locked
UNCERTAIN is a valid earned state and must remain available when the public evidence does not support a stronger read
One declared read per street preserves the trace instead of silently overwriting an earlier interpretation
Every Human Game read must preserve alternative explanations and a next-test route when a stronger claim is not earned
Low sample size must remain insufficient rather than being inflated into confidence
Later contact may strengthen weaken or reverse an earlier behavioural read
Physical visualisation of chips may represent values already shown to the player but must not create a second bankroll authority
Card-reveal presentation may respond to already-visible cards but must not predict or inspect undealt cards
A visible-card equity estimate is an estimate against an unknown range; it is not knowledge of House Mind's hidden cards
Unrevealed House cards must remain absent from archived fold history
Local active-hand restoration must preserve the exact 52-card state without duplicate or missing card identities
Raise sizing changes decision expression but does not create a second betting-state authority
All-in closure may run out cards only when no further betting decision is possible
Royal progression must become visible in the world rather than existing only as text
Portrait Academy may personify cards; Royal Table remains ceremonial and more realistic
Premium composition must improve focal clarity rather than merely add ornament
Both presentation routes deserve authored environments rather than primary and fallback status
Deep House depth must carry game or progression meaning rather than exist as decoration alone
Direct contact must produce a perceivable bounded visual consequence without obscuring the field centre or primary action
Composition enrichment must preserve PUKA identity and the protected poker field
Shared Deep House law does not merge PUKA with JM Visual Crown or erase route identity
Phone portrait routes to Portrait Academy; phone landscape routes to Royal Table
Protect playfield before setup chrome
Visible interactive contacts use a 44px minimum estate floor
Estate browser acceptance uses real separate contexts, exact requested viewport identity and zero horizontal overflow
Viewport proof uses viewport-only screenshots from the rendered output context; same-size screenshots alone do not prove viewport context
Automated lifecycle proof does not equal installed physical Android lifecycle proof
Real-viewport structural proof does not equal aesthetic crown or owner physical-device acceptance
Visual quality is a completion gate, not decoration after completion
Observation != interpretation != fact
Estimate != hidden fact
Pattern != proof of motive
Pattern != proof
Contradiction != failure
Supported != proved
Different games may share organs without sharing identities
One singular live direct door is the normal owner contact route
No Ding, no completion claim
No real-money wagering in this stage body
claimBoundary: Human Game comparative Pattern Window stage over the v0.16A Counterread calibration organ, v0.15A Declared Read Lab, v0.14A behavioural-read engine, v0.13A Deep House visual-convergence body and v0.12A full-table learning loop. Automated syntax/core/Human-Game/Read-Lab/Calibration/Pattern-Window proof may establish the visible-action membrane, hidden-field rejection, declared-read trace, public-consequence correction, confidence calibration, bounded recent-window comparison, same-signal contradiction handling and recent-versus-longer directional change. It does not establish motive, personality diagnosis, truth about a real-world person, owner-side aesthetic acceptance, installed physical Android lifecycle persistence, Cold Ding or final visual crown. Those remain separate and unclaimed.
